text:
jess: FYI Acme reported missing tokens/sec on console for their us-east-ingest (lots of zeros and a few negative spikes). billing shows an unexpected credit. Can we triage?

support-bot: ticket #INC-91234 created, paging on-call.

sanjay: looking. can you grab a screenshot of the graph + time range? and customer region + org id?

jess: attached screenshot (link) for window 2023-11-02 14:00-16:00 UTC. org: acme-corp-42, stream: us-east-ingest, model-route: text-generate-v2.

elaine: initial thought: rollup aggregator might have misaligned windows for TTL-based evictions — that can produce 0/negative deltas if checkpoint offset jumps. any deploys to rollup/streaming in the last 12h?

mike: infra saw a consumer rebalance at 2023-11-02T15:05:12Z for group tokensec-agg-us-east. stacktrace from consumer logs shows IllegalStateException in commit loop then restart. might be related.

sanjay: can we get kafka consumer status? mike, can you paste consumer-groups output for tokensec-agg-us-east?

mike: sure, output: ```bash
$ kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka.us-east:9092 --group tokensec-agg-us-east --describe
TOPIC                          PARTITION  CURRENT-OFFSET  LOG-END-OFFSET  LAG  CONSUMER-ID
us-east-ingest-tokensec          23         1048576         1048584         8   consumer-3-...
us-east-ingest-tokensec          42         0               0               0   -
```

alexa: note partition 42 showing 0/0 and consumer id missing — that's suspicious (maybe partition got deleted and re-created with fresh offsets). if aggregator expects monotonic offsets, deltas go negative.

jess: that matches the times customer saw zeros right after 15:05. billing credited tokens because the billing job reads tokens/sec windows and subtracts negative deltas (bug).

elaine: to reproduce locally: 1) create a topic, produce messages up to offset X, 2) delete/ recreate partition (or roll topic cut), 3) run rollup consumer which persists last-processed-offset per partition, 4) inject a reset so current-offset < persisted-offset -> see negative delta.

sanjay: thanks. we should: (A) clamp negative deltas at aggregation time, (B) backfill affected windows, (C) find root cause of partition reset. any objections?

mike: agree. i can patch agg to clamp and emit a metric agg.negative_clamped=1 when it happens. also will add a reconciliation that detects a consumer lag spike due to partition reassign.

alexa: i'll run a targeted backfill for acme-corp-42 for 2023-11-02 14:30-16:00 UTC. command: ```bash
$ ./tools/tokensec-backfill --org acme-corp-42 --stream us-east-ingest --from "2023-11-02T14:30:00Z" --to "2023-11-02T16:00:00Z" --force-clamp
```

support-bot: scheduled backfill job JOB-1245 queued (ETA ~8m).

jess: customer asked about billing impact — how big is the credit? finance showed ~-1.2k tokens on 11/02, invoice pending.

elaine: if we clamp and backfill, that should neutralize the negative entry and re-run billing. put a hold on invoicing until we confirm. ops: please pause auto-invoice for acme-corp-42.

mike: deploy-bot: rolling out agg-clamp patch to canary.

deploy-bot: @mike initiated canary deploy: rollup-agg v2.3.1-canary id=c-8852 to tokensec-agg-us-east (2 instances).

sanjay: can we also add an alert rule for negative-delta-rate > 0.1% of windows in a minute? that would catch regressions faster.

alexa: done — created alert RULE-NEG-DELTA and set paging to eng-runtime.

support-bot: backfill JOB-1245 started, progress 0% -> 60% -> 100%.

mike: canary observed 3 clamps in first 10m, agg.negative_clamped=3 metric emitted, no errors. proceeding to roll full cluster.

jess: backfill completed. updated dashboard for acme shows tokens/sec restored, billing recalculated. customer confirmed console looks normal.

elaine: root cause follow-up: discovered an automated topic compact job during maintenance that re-created topics with fewer partitions causing offset resets. created PR to block topic recreation without updating persisted partition state.

sanjay: closing loop: created postmortem draft and action items: (1) clamp at agg (merged), (2) reconcile job to detect offset regressions (in progress), (3) billing job to ignore negative deltas until reconciliation (hotfix), (4) ops runbook for topic recreation.

jess: noted — resolving INC-91234 and will notify customer. thanks all :thumbsup:

support-bot: INC-91234 marked resolved.
